legal.privacyIntro: How Jompancing collects and uses your information.

privacySections.title: Who we are
privacySections.body: Jompancing (jompancing.my) is a Malaysia fishing community platform. We help anglers share spots, join activities, and connect on gear listings.

privacySections.title: Information we collect
privacySections.body: Account info (name, email, profile photo via Google or email sign-in), content you post (spots, photos, forum posts, comments, marketplace listings, activities), and approximate location when you choose GPS features.

privacySections.title: How we use it
privacySections.body: To run the service: show your posts to other users, keep you signed in, improve maps and search, and prevent abuse. We do not sell your personal data.

privacySections.title: Third parties
privacySections.body: We use Supabase (database & auth), Vercel (hosting), and Google (Maps & address search). WhatsApp contact for marketplace and activities happens off-platform between users.

privacySections.title: Your choices
privacySections.body: You can delete spots you own, sign out anytime, or contact us to request account deletion. Guest (anonymous) spot posts still create a temporary auth session to upload photos.

termsSections.title: Acceptance
termsSections.body: By using Jompancing you agree to these terms. If you disagree, please do not use the site.

termsSections.title: Your content
termsSections.body: You keep ownership of photos and text you post. You grant us a licence to display and share them on the platform so other anglers can see them. Do not post illegal content, private property trespass encouragement, or others' photos without permission.

termsSections.title: Community conduct
termsSections.body: Be respectful. No harassment, spam, scams, or false spot information. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules.

termsSections.title: Marketplace & activities
termsSections.body: Buy/sell and event listings are user-generated. COD and meet-ups are between users — Jompancing is not a party to those transactions and is not responsible for disputes, injuries, or losses.

termsSections.title: Fishing & safety
termsSections.body: Fishing involves risk. Check local laws, licences, and weather. Spot locations are user-submitted and may be inaccurate. You are responsible for your own safety.

termsSections.title: Disclaimer
termsSections.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranties. We may change or discontinue features at any time.
